description: Date Math does deterministic calendar and time-zone arithmetic for AI agents. POST JSON to /v1/diff (calendar and total difference between two dates or datetimes, business days with custom holidays), /v1/add (add or subtract years, months, weeks, days, business days or time; month-end clamping), /v1/convert (instant or local wall-clock time between IANA time zones, DST-aware) or /v1/info (weekday, ISO week, quarter, day of year, leap year). Every response is a JSON object; errors are JSON 4xx with an error object. No upstream calls; identical input gives identical output on every supplier (except /v1/convert with datetime "now").

rpc_types.backend_hint: date-math HTTPS backend; reference deployment is a Cloudflare Worker at the docs URL. Mount at /.
rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/diff, /v1/add, /v1/convert, /v1/info; GET /v1/version, /v1/health and /v1/openapi.json. Every response is a JSON object.

specs.notes: OpenAPI 3.1 with example requests; also served by the backend at GET /v1/openapi.json.

serving.backend: date-math Worker (TypeScript, Hono, no dependencies beyond Intl). No auth toward the backend; callers cannot send headers. No upstream calls; responses are uncompressed and finish in milliseconds.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service so a wrong backend cannot be staked under this id.
Functional probe: known leap day; checks the computed weekday. Cheap and deterministic.

serving.notes: Upstream: none. Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"]. RelayMiner: rest backend pointed at the Worker URL, health check GET /v1/health expecting "ok".
